posts.author: Paulbiplab
posts.text: The chemicals business is having a general tailwind, unless your entire consumption is local. India & China are the biggest suppliers of raw materials to major specialty chemicals manufacturers, especially to Middle East. The logistic issues due to West Asia crisis has hit them hard. Just o give an example, a shipment can arrive in 3 months against 1 month, but the backlog in the port is so huge that to get it out is a bigger struggle.
